items.prompt: Which relationship supplies the intended cross-thread visibility edge here?

options.text: One thread waited for a second on a clock
options.why: Time passing is not the specified edge.

options.text: Unlock and a subsequent successful lock of the same mutex
options.why: Within-thread sequencing combines with the synchronization edge.

options.text: Two threads used different local mutexes
options.why: That does not establish this shared-data protocol.

options.text: A cache line happens to contain both fields

items.explanation: Use the specified same-object synchronization edge, not a scheduling coincidence.
